feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
entry.summary: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

entry.title: From DOGE to space lasers, Alex Gibney peels back the many layers of Elon Musk
entry.summary: In the Oscar-winning filmmaker's latest documentary, director Alex Gibney investigates the rise of Elon Musk and says what's behind Musk's success are distressing truths.

entry.title: Empty seats, socialism and Trump dominate the Republican midterm convention
entry.summary: The two day Republican convention in Dallas showcased the party's biggest asset in trying to win competitive midterm races and its greatest obstacle: President Trump.

entry.title: These Michigan swing voters are bracing for higher prices from trade war with Canada
entry.summary: President Trump's tariff standoff with Canada is rankling some key voters ahead of this year's midterm elections.

entry.title: Vance, Trump urge Americans to support Republicans on last night of convention
entry.summary: Vice President Vance delivered remarks at the final night of the Republican Midterm Convention, as President Trump relished his last convention as the Republican Party's dominant leader.

entry.title: Republican strategist shares takeaways from Vance's speech at the GOP convention
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Republican strategist Rina Shah about the main takeaways from Vice President Vance's speech at the Republican Midterm Convention.

entry.title: Lawsuit challenges intimidation of DHS observers across the country
entry.summary: The sweeping lawsuit brought by Common Cause argues federal agencies are illegally surveilling and intimidating people who try to peacefully observe federal immigration enforcement activity.

entry.title: After court flurry, Missouri officials set aside GOP redistricting
entry.summary: After a flurry of court maneuvers, the Republican redistricting of U.S. House seats in Missouri is blocked. It's a win for Democrats fighting to win control of the House — but maybe not over yet.

entry.title: Anti-Muslim rhetoric is finding a growing foothold in GOP messaging ahead of November
entry.summary: A strain of anti-Muslim bigotry has become increasingly common in GOP politics, manifesting everywhere from a "Sharia-free America" caucus in Congress to rhetoric on the campaign trail.

entry.title: In divided times, Gov. Cox prescribes passionate disagreement, minus contempt
entry.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Spencer Cox, Republican governor of Utah, about his new book, Off Ramp, and his vision for peacemaking.
